      About Vkalpa Innovations

      Founded in 2012 in Bengaluru, Vkalpa Innovations solves real-world problems with intelligent, practical, future-ready solutions. For over a decade we have paired SAP and enterprise technology with deep industry expertise across semiconductor and mechanical manufacturing, aerospace, software development and AI.

      Innovation

      Practical, future-ready answers to real problems.

      Resilience

      Systems, solutions and teams that adapt and keep performing under pressure.

      Assurance

      Since 2012, our team has delivered technology consulting, AI solutions, recruitment and business services for global enterprises.
